column1: # Algorithms vocabulary for PHASE 2 — blind spots and speculative flags only.
# Derived from the `algorithm` verdicts in axes_models/ROUTING.tsv. Deliberately
# carries NO counts and is sorted ALPHABETICALLY, not by frequency: the corpus
# bounds scope and exposes blind spots, it never arbitrates (B.5 — a corpus-count
# file leaking into the derivation is a recorded defect). Surfaces that differ
# only orthographically are collapsed onto one row; nothing semantic is merged.
# An acronym claimed by two different long forms is AMBIGUOUS and resolves to
# neither: `iql` is both Implicit and Independent Q-Learning, so only the
# spelled-out forms are names and the bare string needs paper context.
